question: Hosted SMS and MMS messaging is a different Telnyx offer from the object and cloud storage records already in the corpus (storage/telnyx-object-storage, storage/telnyx-cloud-storage). This draft must remain a separate dev-services record and not be folded into those storage records. Should the integrator add a relate op of kind variant_of, or keep the records unrelated?
why: The provider name collides with existing Telnyx storage records, but the service, pricing unit and interface differ; an automatic same-provider merge would conflate two offers.
